name: Chimapuri.
source:
As punishment for cheating, a prince of a certain kingdom was cursed by a witch to shrink.
Using the power of love, try to bring him back to his regular size.

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5551]Freem![/url]]
translation:
某个王国的王子因为出轨，被女巫施加诅咒，变得只有原来那么小。
试着用爱的力量，让他恢复原本的大小。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5551]Freem![/url]]
